issues.t: 10-speed automatic valve body failure
issues.sym: Hesitation, hard or jerky shifts, the car dropping out of gear, or a sudden loss of drive at speed. The check engine light may only come on after the failure.
issues.why: The control valve body inside the 10-speed automatic can stick or wear. Owners report repeat repairs, parts delays and in some cases a full transmission replacement.
issues.next: If shifts turn harsh or the car slips out of gear, get it to a Cadillac dealer quickly and ask about GM's bulletin and the related recall. Keep records of every visit.

issues.t: Transmission damage can lock the rear wheels (recall)
issues.sym: Harsh shifts or transmission warnings, and in rare cases the rear wheels can lock while driving.
issues.why: Internal damage in the 10-speed automatic can lock the wheels. GM's fix adds software that watches for the damage and protects the car.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V148000 and have the free software installed. Don't ignore harsh shifts or transmission messages.

issues.t: Power steering and brake assist suddenly reduced
issues.sym: A wave of warning lights comes on at once (stability, ABS, collision, tire pressure) with 'Steering assist is reduced' and a hard steering wheel or hard brake pedal. Restarting the car sometimes clears it.
issues.why: Owners report communication faults between modules, and in some cases a brake control module was replaced. GM has a bulletin with extra steps for no-crank or loss-of-power-steering faults.
issues.next: Pull over safely if steering or braking feels wrong. Have the dealer save the stored codes right away and unplug any aftermarket plug-in devices from the diagnostic port.

issues.t: Brake assist can be lost (recall)
issues.sym: A hard brake pedal that needs much more force, often with brake warning messages.
issues.why: A contaminated sensor connection in the electronic brake booster can interrupt its signal and cut power assist.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V588000. The dealer replaces the brake boost module for free.

issues.t: Brake warnings and hard pedal from failed brake control module
issues.sym: Several warning lights when braking and a pedal that feels wrong or nearly fails. Some owners needed more than one module.
issues.why: Owners report failures of the electronic brake control module and related parts on cars not covered by the brake boost recall.
issues.next: Treat any brake warning as urgent. Ask the dealer whether your car falls under the brake recall or a GM bulletin before paying.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may be installed wrong (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning signs.
issues.why: The roof-rail curtain airbags may not have been installed correctly, so they might not deploy as designed in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V611000. The dealer inspects and reinstalls the airbags for free.

issues.t: Airbag warning light may not work correctly (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light may come on at random or fail to warn of a real fault.
issues.why: Software in the gateway module doesn't handle a lost link with the airbag module properly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V421000. The fix is a free software update, over the air or at a dealer.

issues.t: Daytime running lights stay on with headlights (recall)
issues.sym: The daytime running lights stay bright when the headlights are on, which can glare at other drivers.
issues.why: Body control module software doesn't dim or turn off the running lights as the federal standard requires.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V903000. The fix is a free software update.

issues.t: Oil leak at the camshaft carrier
issues.sym: A burning oil smell, oil spots under the car, or a shop finding oil seeping from the top of the engine during an oil change.
issues.why: Sealer at the camshaft carrier gasket joint can be applied wrong at the factory and seep oil. GM issued a bulletin on this leak.
issues.next: Have the leak confirmed and fixed while under warranty if you can. Oil dripping on the exhaust can smoke and smell, so don't put it off.

issues.t: Check engine light from a failed purge pump
issues.sym: Check engine light with code P1467 (purge pump speed too low). The car usually drives normally.
issues.why: The evaporative purge pump, which helps pull fuel vapor into the engine, can fail. GM issued special coverage for this pump on the 2.0L engine.
issues.next: Ask a Cadillac dealer with your VIN whether the special coverage applies. The pump is replaced as a unit.

issues.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
issues.sym: The engine hesitates and dies, sometimes at highway speed, with warning lights. In a few cases the dealer found the engine needed replacing.
issues.why: Owners report stalls with no stored codes and, at low miles, internal engine failure needing a new engine.
issues.next: Get off the road safely and have the car towed. Ask the dealer to record all codes and freeze-frame data, and keep paperwork in case of repeat failures.

issues.t: Hesitation, engine flare or harsh shifts when pulling away
issues.sym: The engine revs up but the car hesitates, especially on the first drive of the day, or shifts feel harsh or delayed.
issues.why: GM has bulletins on harsh or delayed shifts and some normal delay when you press the gas quickly. Some cases come from transmission control valve wear.
issues.next: Have the dealer check for transmission software updates and bulletins. If it gets worse or the car slips, ask for a full transmission check.

issues.t: Shudder or flutter when cylinders shut off to save fuel
issues.sym: A shudder, buzz or loss of power under acceleration, or a flutter felt through the car at steady speeds.
issues.why: The engine shuts off cylinders at light load to save fuel. GM issued a bulletin for flutter noise through the engine mounts in this mode.
issues.next: Mention it to the dealer and ask about the engine mount bulletin. Shudder under hard acceleration should be checked for misfires.

issues.t: Squeak or squeal from brake pad wear sensors
issues.sym: A squeak or squeal at low speed or under light braking, even with new brakes.
issues.why: The brake pad wear sensors can touch the rotor. GM issued a bulletin and a service update for the noise.
issues.next: Have the dealer check the wear sensors under the bulletin. If the noise means the pads are worn, replace the pads.

issues.t: Rear wheels lock up with a bang and flashing 'D'
issues.sym: A loud bang, rear wheel lockup or ABS activity during light acceleration, with a flashing 'D' on the dash.
issues.why: GM issued a bulletin describing this condition.
issues.next: Pull over safely and have the car towed to a dealer. Ask about this bulletin and the 10-speed transmission recall.

issues.t: Overheating warning from a faulty coolant temperature sensor
issues.sym: Overheat warning or check engine light even though the engine may not truly be hot, or coolant leaking near a valve on the engine.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins for coolant temperature sensors that read wrong, a coolant control valve that can leak, and electric coolant pump connection faults.
issues.next: Don't drive if the gauge or warning says overheating. Have the dealer check the sensor and the coolant control valve.

issues.t: 'No fob detected' and won't start
issues.sym: The car shows 'No Fob Detected' and won't crank, even with the key fob inside.
issues.why: GM bulletins point to an internal fault in the body control module, or to fob detection problems.
issues.next: Try the backup fob pocket or spot shown in the owner's manual. If it keeps happening, the dealer may need to replace the body control module.

issues.t: Auto stop/start stops working with battery warning
issues.sym: Auto stop/start no longer shuts the engine off at lights, and a battery monitor or check engine light comes on.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins for stop/start being disabled with stored codes, often tied to battery state or battery monitoring.
issues.next: Have the battery tested and the codes read. A weak battery is a common cause.

issues.t: Driver-assist features unavailable or 'Service Driver Assist'
issues.sym: 'Service Driver Assist' or steering assist messages at startup, and lane keeping or other assist features won't work.
issues.why: GM bulletins tie some cases to the front camera, which may need to be replaced.
issues.next: Have the dealer check for the bulletins. Drive without relying on assist features until it's fixed.

issues.t: Weak or no cabin heat
issues.sym: The heater blows cool air or never gets warm enough.
issues.why: GM issued a repair procedure for loss of cabin heat on this car.
issues.next: Check the coolant level first, then have the dealer check the bulletin.

issues.t: Rattle from the starter
issues.sym: A rattle from the engine area, often at startup.
issues.why: GM issued a bulletin on replacing the starter when it is the source of a rattle.
issues.next: Have the dealer confirm where the rattle comes from.

issues.t: Radio and chimes lose sound or audio drains the battery
issues.sym: No sound from the radio, turn signal clicks or chimes, or the audio switching on by itself and running the battery down.
issues.why: Owners report audio system faults that point to the radio or amplifier.
issues.next: Have the dealer check for infotainment software updates. A battery that goes flat overnight needs a parasitic draw test.

issues.t: Electric parking brake keeps setting itself
issues.sym: The electric parking brake applies on its own, or keeps setting when you don't want it to.
issues.why: Owners report the electric parking brake engaging unexpectedly, which points to a switch, module or software fault.
issues.next: Have the brake codes read. Check that the auto-apply setting isn't simply turned on.

issues.t: Brake light out from water in the tail light
issues.sym: One brake light stops working.
issues.why: Moisture gets into the tail lamp and corrodes the contacts.
issues.next: Have the lamp checked for water. The lamp or its connector may need replacing.

issues.t: Wavy or distorted windshield
issues.sym: Ripples or distortion when looking through the windshield.
issues.why: An owner reports factory and replacement windshields with the same ripples.
issues.next: Ask a glass shop to inspect it. Distortion that affects your view should be fixed under warranty.

issues.t: Manual gearbox grinds or won't go into second
issues.sym: On the manual Blackwing, the shifter is hard to move from first to second, only partly engages, grinds or loses drive.
issues.why: An owner reports hard shifting and grinding into second gear, which points to a synchronizer or clutch problem.
issues.next: Have the clutch and transmission checked under warranty. Don't force the shifter.

issues.t: Low oil pressure warning
issues.sym: The low oil pressure light comes on. After repairs some owners hear loud engine noises.
issues.why: An owner reports a low oil pressure warning at low miles, followed by a rear main seal replacement and new noises.
issues.next: Stop the engine right away if the oil pressure light comes on. Check the oil level and have the car towed if it's low.
